mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen addition usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on the size and complexity of the addition, but many Denver-area kitchen remodels and additions take several weeks to a few months once construction starts. Permit review, engineering, material lead times, and changes to plumbing or structure can extend the schedule. A smaller bump-out may move faster than a full expansion.
acceptedAnswer.description: A small kitchen addition may take weeks, while a more complex expansion can take months once design and permits are included. Structural changes and permit review are the biggest schedule drivers.
